QuestInfo.name: [Advice from Dr. Pepper] A Genuine Smile
QuestInfo.0: You'll need to win the trust of the people to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to Dr. Pepper to learn how to leave a good impression on others. She's the expert, after all.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Pepper says you'll need a Genuine Smile. Defeat monsters to get self-help books to learn all about it. You'll need to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k to find the self-help books.\n\n #rTip: This quest is repeatable if you lose your Genuine Smile.
QuestInfo.2: You're received a Genuine Smile from Dr. Pepper!

0.0: If you want to be an M-Forcer, you have to win the trust of the people, right? Everyone thinks I'm the nicest person around because I'm smiling all the time. That's what you have to learn: how to always have a Genuine Smile.
0.1: But I'm busy trying to perfect this fizzy potion to compete with that OTHER stupid soda. Go read a self-help book. Browsing through 10 copies of #bA Better You: Learning to Laugh at Yourself#k should help you learn all about faking, I mean, having a Genuine Smile.

yes.0: You can get the self-help book by hunting monsters. Just don't bother with any that are #bover 21 levels above you.#k They're 'too good' to need to improve themselves.

no.0: I see how it is. Think you're better than the rest of us? NO POTIONS FOR YOU... hiccup!

1.0: Did you read the books? Sorry if I'm not paying attention. I had to make up a whole new batch of potions because I drank all of my last batch... hiccup!
